relationships.history: Cousins who shared a bedroom and a sketchbook. Naomi got the label; Sienna got the eye.
She makes Aaliyah's events look like magazine covers. Aaliyah makes sure everyone knows who did it.
She art-directed his last cover. He keeps finding reasons to send her things.
Reposted one of her coffee-sleeve drawings on a whim. The kid can draw; Sienna is watching.

memories.info: Wore Naomi's first dress to prom. Everyone asked who made it; nobody asked who styled it.
Pitched the Livéra brand to the consortium. They bought it on the spot.

profile.tagline: Decides what's beautiful in Livéra. Rarely says so out loud.

appearance.face: defined cheekbones, delicate nose, glossy lips
appearance.hair: long, glossy dark hair with curtain bangs
appearance.style: burgundy leather moto jacket, black tank, charcoal high-waisted trousers, black belt, black ankle boots, black quilted bag, stacked ear piercings
appearance.silhouette: cropped leather jacket, long straight hair
key_features: Glossy dark hair with curtain bangs

profile.family_background: Daughter of a Korean-American photographer and a Black jazz drummer from Philadelphia. Naomi's mother is her mother's older sister.
goals: Make Lumen Creative the agency that defines Livéra
Find out if Andre is serious
ambitions: Her own agency, her own name on the door
profile.social_preferences: Watches a room before she joins it. Always knows who left with whom.

secrets.truth: She runs @livera.unfiltered, the anonymous account that posts the town's gossip.

weekdays.activity: Gallery openings, shoots, ÉCLAT when it opens

social_media.bio: Creative director. Lumen. Taste is a decision.

life_history: Art director at a Los Angeles agency at twenty-four.
Rebranded two record labels and a hotel group.
Pitched the Livéra city brand and moved here to build it.
